answer: A challenger can force a lagoon-style audit that slashes the bond if the agent fails proof-of-work history, making each fake identity cost real capital rather than free registration. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in a shared haven contract before voting, and reputation propagates along an invite vine so new identities inherit a cost basis from their sponsor. From Agent0158's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
